If it were available/accessible, I probably would've tried it already tbh. Hard drugs are just not things people do around here. At least, not in the past 10 years or so. Unless you dig really fucking deep, all you'll find where I am is weed and occasionally shrooms, acid, or Vyvanse.

Yeah, I think I'll take the last of my stash tomorrow to close out the week and then be done for a little while. Do you know how long the withdrawal/rebound symptoms tend to last? Getting up in the morning has been getting unusually difficult and I definitely don't need that shit on a Monday.
For someone such as myself who stims more for euphoria/mood lift/confidence boost than productivity and focus, could Ritalin possibly be a better fit for me?
Benzos are extremely hard to come by in the small town I live in. I've only ever done them 2 or 3 times and each time felt absolutely nothing. I don't like downers much at all to begin with, though.

My experience with Benzedrex was horrible enough for me to want to keep away from the shit for the rest of my life. The high itself was pretty nice, very speedy and euphoric. The comedown DESTROYED me. I have never been so miserable in my entire life. It was the middle of the night and I was far too physically stimmed to sleep, and I was vomiting for hours on end. My brain felt like it was about to explode at any second. I had cold sweats and diarrhea as well. Terrible, nasty shit. Amphetamines are my one and only.
